meta.title: Situate — Put AI to work on your to-dos
meta.description: Personal organization with AI. Use your notes, tasks and documents to prepare replies and next steps, with results for you to review.
nav.label: Explore Situate
hero.product: Your notes, tasks and documents in one free app—with AI to help prepare replies and next steps.
hero.alt: Birthday plans in Situate, with guest numbers, food choices and preparations for the evening.
ribbon.two: A head start on what’s next.
story.title:
One email.
The next steps, ready.
story.intro: You’re planning a birthday. The venue needs a few details. Situate brings the answers together and prepares the next steps.
step1.kicker: 01 / The venue needs a few things
step1.title:
The answers are there.
Just not together.
step1.body: Guest numbers in a note. Timings in a PDF. An agreement in an earlier email. Before you can reply, you need to bring them together.
step1.quote: Could you send the final guest count, dietary requirements and running order? Let me know what sound equipment you need, too.
step1.source: Maya at Willow Room · A few final details
step2.title: Give it the job. Not every detail.
step2.body: Situate uses your birthday notes, saved running order and earlier emails to prepare the reply. You give it the task, rather than gathering every detail yourself.
step2.quote: Draft a reply to Maya’s latest email about my birthday. Attach the running order and add the key handover to my calendar.
step3.title:
Ready in Gmail.
Already in your calendar.
step3.body: A draft in Gmail, with the running order attached. The key handover in your calendar, with no invitations sent. Check the details, edit the reply and send it when you’re ready.
step3.one: A reply to Maya, saved in Gmail
story.screen2: A short request, with context behind it
story.screen3: A Gmail draft and a calendar entry
story.alt1: Situate showing birthday notes with guest numbers, food choices and plans for the evening.
story.alt2: Birthday notes beside a short request to draft the venue reply and add the key handover, without manually attached sources.
story.alt3: Situate conversation with the venue reply, its attached running order and confirmation of the key handover in Google Calendar. The email remains a draft.
faq.title: Before you try it.
faq.two.q: What do I need to set up?
faq.two.a: Bring your notes and tasks into Situate. For AI help, connect a supported provider or a compatible local model. Email and calendar services need separate connections.
faq.three.a: The entire app is free. Your chosen AI provider may charge for usage.

overview.label: Why Situate
overview.local.title:
Your files.
On your device.
overview.local.body: Notes, tasks and saved documents live on your device. Read and edit them without internet or AI.
overview.personal.title:
Tools that work
your way.
overview.personal.body: Ask Situate to adapt your tools, views and workflows to how you organize—not the other way around.
overview.portable.title:
Open formats.
No lock-in.
overview.portable.body: Notes and tasks use Markdown. Saved documents stay ordinary files. You’re not tied to Situate—take your files to another app whenever you want.
product.title: How Situate works — Situate
product.description: A personal organization app that adapts to you. Bring notes, tasks and documents together, get AI help with the work, and keep your independence.
product.line1: An organization app that adapts to you.
product.body: Situate brings your notes, tasks and documents together. Tell it how you work, and ask it to adapt your tools and help with the work.
product.benefit.work.title: Work your way.
product.benefit.work.body: Lists, views and workflows shaped around you.
product.benefit.help.title: Get help with the work.
product.benefit.help.body: Use your information to prepare replies and next steps.
product.benefit.independence.title: Stay independent.
product.benefit.independence.body: Choose your AI. Keep files you can use in other apps.
product.example.request: “I keep tasks in my project notes. Give me one view of everything still open.”
product.example.caption: Tasks stay in your notes. See what’s open together.
product.end.eyebrow: A place for what you want to do
product.end.title:
Make it
your own.
product.end.body: Start with your own notes and tasks. Add the connections and tools that help you.
space.title:
Your information.
A head start on what’s next.
space.body: Bring your notes and tasks into Situate and connect the document sources you choose. Ask AI to use that context to prepare replies and next steps—or work with it directly.
space.notes.title: Keep tasks with the notes they belong to.
space.notes.body: A plan, the details behind it, and the things still to do. Keep them together instead of maintaining a separate list for every app.
space.documents.title: Find the details behind the next step.
space.documents.body: Bring your chosen document sources into one view. Find a running order, check an agreement, and use those details in a reply.
space.workspace.title: A request, with the context beside it.
space.workspace.body: Keep a note beside the conversation. Ask for a draft based on your information, then review the result before sending it.
space.alt.notes: Birthday plans open in Situate’s file reader.
space.alt.documents: Situate’s document collection with the birthday running order and venue documents.
space.alt.workspace: Birthday notes beside the request to prepare a reply to the venue.
plugins.title:
Keep your habits.
Change your tools.
plugins.body: Keep tasks in project notes or separate lists. Prefer a different view or need a connection? Describe it in your own words, and work with Situate to create the tool as a plugin.
plugins.aside: Start with useful tools. Add what’s missing.
plugins.screen: A place for your own tools
plugins.alt: Situate’s Plugins view with installed tools and the option to create a plugin.
models.title:
Your tools can change.
Your files stay yours.
models.body: Choose your AI, including local models. Keep your notes and saved documents in files you can use without Situate.
models.providerBody: Connect supported access to OpenAI, Anthropic or OpenRouter. Provider terms, available methods and usage charges still apply.
models.localBody: Use a suitable OpenAI-compatible server, including one you run locally. The server must be reachable and support the capabilities your work needs.
models.manualBody: Keep reading and editing locally stored material manually. AI is help you choose, not a requirement for opening your own notes.
models.alt: Situate’s AI and model settings with provider connections and chat choices.
models.processing: Cloud AI processes the content you send to it.
free.title:
Start with your notes.
Not a blank canvas.
free.body: The entire app is free. Bring your notes and tasks into Situate. Start with the built-in tools, then add the connections and workflows you need.
free.appBody: Organize your notes, tasks and documents, and add your own tools. It’s all included.
free.offlineBody: Read and edit the files stored on your device without internet or AI.
free.costs: Your chosen AI provider may charge for usage.
open.title:
Open your files
without Situate.
open.body: Notes and tasks are Markdown files. Saved documents stay ordinary files. Open them in other apps or take them with you—no export required.
open.code: Read Situate’s public source code to see how the app works.
